responsibility: Generates the macro, micro and you-are-here views from authority without storing any of them.
failure_boundary: fail_open on completeness and fail_closed on invention — with no events recorded the marker reports no position rather than asserting one, and nothing in the view is written back to authority
recovery_behavior: Regenerated from authority on every call and never cached, so it is correct immediately after any restart and cannot be left stale by an interrupted write
replacement_contract: A replacement must derive progress and position from authority alone, expose macro stage with selected-module progress and micro steps per transaction, and must not persist a position of its own
evidence_produced: you_are_here with the derived_from pointer naming the event seq it came from
macro counts of contracted, authorized and executed modules
